incidents.name: pNetwork Burner convertAndBurn slippage sandwich
incidents.notes: Burner.convertAndBurn() is permissionless and swaps the contract's accumulated USDT/WBTC into PNT through Uniswap V2 with a zero minimum-output, so the whole conversion could be sandwiched by pre-buying and re-selling PNT in the same transaction.

sources.ref: onchain review: Burner 0x4d4d05e1205e3A412ae1469C99e0d954113aa76F (verified, ContractName Burner) created 2020-07-27T09:39:05Z by 0x2a24a7a4beb9e6d0431c9bc1800045b8fc27a966, not the attack-tx sender 0xe6dcf87256866e293b825708bf1f5df8f07519b3; no EIP-1967 events, immutable since deployment (1394 days). 1.7 ETH at a May 2024 ETH price near $3,700 is roughly $6.3k, above the $1,000 floor. Same failure mode as the recorded CurveBurner row: a permissionless fee-conversion call with no slippage bound. Loss converted at the incident timestamp: 1.7 ETH x $3,661.59 (DefiLlama historical ETH price) = $6,225.
